core_research_thesis: Development of a survival simulation framework for autonomous NPCs in a resource-scarce game engine, integrating neural networks and genetic algorithms for tool progression and homeostasis management
state_of_the_art_prior_art: Neural network architectures for sequential decision-making
Genetic algorithm applications in dynamic optimization problems
Homeostasis modeling in artificial life simulations
Integration of AI and game engines for realistic NPC behavior
proven_facts: Lotka-Volterra equations accurately model population dynamics
Thermoregulation models effectively manage internal temperature
Dehydration and starvation models simulate hunger and thirst
Genetic algorithms optimize solutions through selection and crossover
critical_unanswered_unknowns: Optimal neural network architecture for tool progression in dynamic environments
Effectiveness of genetic algorithms in optimizing NPC behavior under resource scarcity
Impact of homeostasis management on NPC survival and tool progression
Scalability of the survival simulation framework to large game environments
Robustness of the framework to changing environmental pressures

proposed_testable_hypotheses.NPCs using neural networks for tool prog: Comparison of NPC survival rates and tool progression speeds
proposed_testable_hypotheses.Genetic algorithms will optimize NPC beh: Evaluation of NPC fitness and resource utilization over time
proposed_testable_hypotheses.Homeostasis management will significantl: Analysis of NPC survival rates and tool progression speeds with and without homeostasis management

failure_modes_and_risks: NPCs failing to manage homeostasis parameters, leading to premature death
Neural networks converging to suboptimal solutions, hindering tool progression
Genetic algorithms failing to adapt to changing environmental pressures
Simulation framework crashing or becoming unstable due to scalability issues
NPC behavior becoming unrealistic or unengaging due to over-optimization
required_empirical_data_inputs: Environmental pressure data (temperature, resource availability, etc.)
Homeostasis parameter data (hunger, thirst, internal temperature)
Game engine performance and scalability data
